title: ESP32-S31
summary: Espressif ESP32-S3 is a low-cost, low-power system-on-chip with dual-core Xtensa processor, integrated Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 5.0 LE, and a Neural Network Accelerator for on-device AI/ML inference, designed for IoT and edge AI applications.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, power-efficient SoC for building connected IoT devices with embedded AI capabilities
why_valuable: Enables developers to deploy machine learning models directly on low-cost edge devices with Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, democratizing AIoT development
